input.answer: If I have to pick, I'd take option 2, "קיבוץ לפי חברה". Each company gets its own heading with what it charges, "דמי ניהול מהחיסכון: מ־0.54% עד 0.61%", and then all its tracks underneath, so I can look at one company at a time. But I'm not putting money into any of this before I talk to you or the bank. I never got to option 3, the one they marked "מומלץ".

stuck.why: It wasn't clear to me whether these were three different pages or three ways of showing the same thing. One of them had a green 'מומלץ' tag, and I couldn't tell who was recommending it or why.

stuck.where: Screen 2, the first table of option 1
stuck.why: It opens with 'עוקב מדד s&p 500'. That's English letters and shares, which is exactly what I'm afraid of. I nearly left right there.
A coloured ring next to 'מניות' and 'מט"ח' with percentages. I didn't know if 99% was good or bad, and the two dot colours look almost the same to me.

stuck.where: Screens 5–6, the long lists of הראל and מור
stuck.why: Rows and rows of numbers. I got tired and anxious and stopped after the sixth screen.
